messages:
anya-pm: quick sync — post-launch pulse: we have a mix of bugs + feature asks from the first week of cohort customers. want to lock the next 2wk sprint priorities. TL;DR: propose 2 critical bug fixes + 1 customer-facing enhancement. thoughts?
kevin-eng: ok, can you list the top items you mean?
liz-qa: from QA triage: 1) streaming cutouts at p99 on long sessions (high), 2) occasional tokenization mismatch on special chars (med), 3) onboarding flow modal not retaining state (low).
mira-cs: customers also asked for: exportable prompt audit logs (helpful for compliance) and a smaller UX tweak — clearer error states during model fallback. most asked = audit logs.
sam-design: error state polish is cheap-ish — microcopy + spinner placement. audit logs is a medium scope (backend + UI).
anya-pm: my read: streaming cutouts is the biggest customer blocker for power users, and audit logs are a strategic ask for 2 customers with contracts coming up. tokenization mismatch has edge cases but high noise for some non-english inputs.
kevin-eng: streaming cutouts — I can allocate 2 engineers to investigate root cause this week. suspect batching/kv-cache eviction interaction. will need logs from failing sessions. @mira-cs can you surface a few customer session IDs?
mira-cs: sharing 3 session IDs in DM. also one customer sent a repro payload (large context + function calls).
oleg-sre: I'll enable additional tracing on the streaming pipeline for the next 48h (low overhead). Deploy bot: started tracing rollup for stream-worker pool at 1792510000.
kevin-eng: for audit logs — engineering estimated 6 dev-days + 3 frontend-days. could be delivered as MVP (download CSV) within 2 weeks if we deprioritize one enhancement.
anya-pm: options: A) 2 bugs (streaming + tokenization) + small UX polish; B) streaming + audit logs MVP + tokenization triage next cycle. prefer B given commercial asks but open to feedback.
liz-qa: tokenization is mostly unit-testable; if we move it out of the sprint we can have a dedicated test-only spike to contain regressions.
sam-design: if we go with B, I can do audit logs UI mock in 2 days for an MVP CSV/filters layout.
mira-cs: customers with contracts prefer audit logs now. they accept a CSV MVP. +1 for B from CS.
kevin-eng: I'm +1 for B, but need clarity on SLO: streaming fix is still top priority. proposal: reserve 50% of eng capacity for streaming investigations & fixes, 30% for audit logs backend + CSV export, 20% for UX polish & triage.
anya-pm: that split makes sense. scope note: audit logs MVP = event-level rows, user_id, timestamp, prompt (truncated), model/version, outcome. no live UI search v1.
oleg-sre: be careful with PII in prompt fields — we should add redaction flag in export or sample hashing. recommend default truncate to 200 chars and include a hashed id column.
kevin-eng: agree. will implement truncation + hash. add a feature flag so we can flip stricter redaction per customer.
mira-cs: please include customer opt-in checkbox in onboarding for audit export (legal asked).
sam-design: noted — will add opt-in checkbox copy: "Allow export of prompt snippets for audit purposes (truncated)."
liz-qa: to keep releases safe, recommend canary audit-logs behind flag for the 2 customers first, and streaming fix on dedicated canary pool so we don't regress.
anya-pm: plan summary then: choose option B. Sprint goals: 1) Fix streaming cutouts (p99) — canary and rollout plan. 2) Audit logs MVP (CSV export, truncation + hash, opt-in flag for customers) — behind canary. 3) Small UX polish on error states. Acceptance criteria: streaming p99 improved by 30% for affected sessions; audit logs deliverable that customer CS can download; UX polish merged + visual signoff.
kevin-eng: I'll create the engineering tickets and a PR template. linking initial issue: https://github.com/redwood-inference/platform/issues/4821
kevin-eng: rough capacity card in comments.
anya-pm: ok, please assign owners and post a short runbook for rollback in case streaming fix causes perf regressions. oleg-sre can you draft rollback steps?
oleg-sre: drafting now — will post in the incident channel with runbook links.
mira-cs: I'll prep customer comms draft for audit logs MVP and share with legal.
anya-pm: thanks everyone. final call — if no objections by EOD we'll lock scope and ship board this afternoon. :thumbsup:
deploy-bot: reminder: next deploy window is 2026-04-02 18:00 UTC.
kevin-eng: no objections here. locking scope. creating PRs and assigning reviewers.
anya-pm: locked. logging sprint card and will update roadmap. thanks! :tada:
